Answer all questions.  For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. What is the effect of a systematic error on the measurement of a physical quantity?

options.A: It limits the precision of the measured value.
options.B: It limits the range of values obtained in repeated measurements.
options.C: It results in repeated measurements having different values from each other.
options.D: It results in the measured value being different from the correct value.

questions.questionText: A car is accelerated by a constant resultant force of 300N for 5.0s. The variation with time of the velocity, in cms–1, of the car is shown. velocity 150 / cm s–1 120 0 1 2 3 4 5 time / s What is the mass of the car?
An aircraft, initially stationary on a runway, takes off with a speed of 85kmh–1 in a distance of no more than 1.20km. What is the minimum constant acceleration necessary for the aircraft?

An object is fired upwards from horizontal ground. The object has an initial velocity of 20ms–1 at an angle of 45° to the horizontal. Air resistance is negligible. Which statement describes the speed of the object after it is fired until immediately before it reaches the ground again?

options.A: Its speed decreases to a value greater than zero, then increases to 20ms–1.
options.B: Its speed decreases to a value greater than zero, then increases to a value greater than 20ms–1.
options.C: Its speed decreases to zero, then increases to 20ms–1.
options.D: Its speed decreases to zero, then increases to a value less than 20ms–1.

questions.questionText: What is a statement of the principle of conservation of momentum for a system?

options.A: The total momentum and the total kinetic energy are always conserved.
options.B: The total momentum is conserved only in elastic collisions.
options.C: The total momentum is conserved provided that no external forces act.
options.D: The total momentum of each object in the system is the product of its mass and velocity.

questions.questionText: Objects P and Q form an isolated system. Object P has mass 6.0kg and is moving at a speed of 3.0ms–1. Object Q has mass 2.0kg and is moving at a speed of 4.2ms–1 at an angle of 35° to the path of P. Q 2.0 kg 35° P 4.2 m s–1 6.0 kg 3.0 m s–1 Objects P and Q collide and stick together. What is the magnitude of the component of the final momentum of the combined objects in the original direction of P?

An astronaut of mass m in a spacecraft experiences a gravitational force F = mg when stationary on the launchpad. What is the gravitational force on the astronaut when the spacecraft is launched vertically upwards with an acceleration of 0.2g?

The diagram shows a child X of mass 20kg and a child Y of mass 15kg seated on a uniform plank. child X child Y mass 20 kg mass 15 kg pivot plank mass 7.0 kg The plank has a mass of 7.0kg and has a pivot at its midpoint. The plank is horizontal and in equilibrium. Which statement about the weight of the plank is correct?

options.A: The weight of the plank can be considered to be acting at its midpoint.
options.B: The weight of the plank is causing an anticlockwise moment.
options.C: The weight of the plank is causing a clockwise moment.
options.D: The weight of the plank equals the force on the plank from the pivot.

She pushes on the ground with her foot to create a forward force F of 25N on herself and the skateboard, as shown in the diagram. total mass of skateboarder and skateboard 70 kg F = 25 N The skateboarder and skateboard travel forwards a distance of 0.50m before the skateboarder lifts her foot from the ground. A turbine at a hydroelectric power station is situated at a vertical distance of 30m below the level of the surface of a large lake. The water passes through the turbine at a rate of 340m3 per minute. The overall efficiency of the turbine and generator system is 90%. The density of water is 1000kgm–3. What is the useful power output of the power station?

A projectile is launched at 45° to the horizontal with initial kinetic energy E. Assuming air resistance to be negligible, what will be the kinetic energy of the projectile when it reaches its highest point?
A wire is extended by a tensile force so that its deformation is elastic. What is meant by elastic deformation?

options.A: The extension of the wire is proportional to the tensile force.
options.B: The extension of the wire is not proportional to the tensile force.
options.C: When the tensile force is removed, the wire does not return to its original length.
options.D: When the tensile force is removed, the wire returns to its original length.

options.A: It consists of three quarks that must all be the same flavour.
options.B: It consists of three quarks that do not need to be the same flavour.
options.C: It consists of two quarks that must both be the same flavour.
options.D: It consists of two quarks that do not need to be the same flavour.
